dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It says "Danger. Keep out." We can't go in there.
dialogue.reading: ɪt ˈsɛz "ˈdeɪndʒər. ˈkiːp ˈaʊt." wiː ˈkænt ˈɡoʊ ɪn ˈðɛr.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK. Oh, the temple is beautiful!
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ˈoʊ, ðə ˈtɛmpəl ɪz ˈbjuːtəfəl!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, can we take photos here?
dialogue.reading: ɪkˈskjuːz miː, kən wiː ˈteɪk ˈfoʊtoʊz ˈhɪr?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Sorry, no photos. And no parking here, please.
dialogue.reading: ˈsɑːri, ˈnoʊ ˈfoʊtoʊz. ənd ˈnoʊ ˈpɑːrkɪŋ ˈhɪr, ˈpliːz.
